partners.mechanism_chain: HPS1 (HGNC:4967) —DISRUPTS→ melanosome biogenesis (GO:0001719); melanosome biogenesis (GO:0001719) —LEADS_TO→ Albinism (HP:0001001); melanosome biogenesis (GO:0001719) —LEADS_TO→ Bleeding tendency (HP:0001873); TRAPPC11 (HGNC:21509) —DISRUPTS→ autophagy (GO:0006913); autophagy (GO:0006913) —LEADS_TO→ Muscular weakness (HP:0001324); autophagy (GO:0006913) —LEADS_TO→ Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy (HP:0003701). Loss-of-function mutations in HPS1 disrupt melanosome biogenesis, leading to albinism and bleeding tendency. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in TRAPPC11 disrupt the autophagy pathway. Autophagy dysfunction can manifest as muscular weakness and limb-girdle muscular dystrophy. The convergence is on the autophagy pathway, which is implicated in cellular homeostasis and can be affected by defects in lysosomal function and protein trafficking, potentially linking HPS1 and TRAPPC11 dysfunction.

Loss-of-function mutations in TRAPPC2 disrupt intracellular protein trafficking, which in turn disrupts general connective tissue development and integrity, leading to short stature. The convergence occurs at the level of intracellular trafficking, where the disruption in TRAPPC2 function indirectly impacts the processes of lysosome-related organelle biogenesis affected by HPS1 mutations.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that the TRAPP II complex plays no role in the trafficking pathways essential for lysosome-related organelle biogenesis, or that HPS1 has no known interaction or pathway overlap with general intracellular protein trafficking machinery. _(variant: Exome sequencing data from gnomAD showing a high frequency (e.g., >1%) of pathogenic variants in HPS1 or TRAPPC2 in healthy individuals.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanistic link through cellular trafficking pathways could reveal novel therapeutic targets for both HPS1 and SEDT. For example, interventions aimed at improving general intracellular trafficking or lysosomal function might offer a common therapeutic strategy or at least inform disease-specific approaches.
